meta.title: Vendor e-mail when the event is rescheduled
gaps: Open the QA mailboxes and verify each concerned vendor receives exactly one email announcing the new start time.
Verify no other vendor receives the email.
Verify no email is sent to a real supplier.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Open the QA mailboxes and verify each concerned vendor receives exactly one email announcing the new start time.; Verify no other vendor receives the email.; Verify no email is sent to a real supplier.

steps.note: Open an existing event suitable for rescheduling.
Reschedule the event to a new future start time and assert that the reschedule succeeds.

args.need: open the QA mailboxes and verify one rescheduling email with the new start time reaches each concerned vendor, while no other vendor or real supplier receives it

steps.note: Mailbox and email-delivery verification is not expressible by catalog steps.
Assert that no application error is shown after the tester's mailbox inspection step.
